label: Glance Clock - generated scene
info:
A comet running round the rings, with a fading tail.

The point of this flow is not the comet. It is that a scene is a timeline
you upload in ONE call and the clock then plays by itself at 50 frames per
second -- so animation means generating a list of steps, which is a loop in
a function node and a page of copy-paste in YAML.

Sending fills one at a time cannot animate: a scene change only takes
effect on the clock's own ~15 second cycle, so a series of calls gives you
a stutter, not motion.

The second function node builds a 'breathing' scene the same way, to show
the shape generalising. Change COLOR and SLOT to taste.

name: generate the timeline
fill, then pulse it
